'''Mistress Anford''' is a clerk in the [[Royal Palace of Andor]].

==Appearance==
Mistress Anford is an elderly woman with graying hair.{{ref/book|11|17}}

==Activities==
Mistress Anford regularly brings reports to [[Birgitte Silverbow|Birgitte Trahelion]].{{ref/book|11|17}} Even during the attacks on [[Caemlyn]], Mistress Anford keeps order in the Map Room.{{ref/book|11|32}}
